title: PAH-OMC-011 Gibbs-state-weighted common-core eventual generator intertwining
question: For the unchanged PAH-001 functional and rates, PAH-OMC-004 neutral inclusion and R-488/OMC-010 cylinder algebra, does a single eventual generator intertwining hold for every finite-support cylinder on the full fixed-Q state spaces?
method: Hash-pin PAH-001, PAH-OMC-004, PAH-OMC-008, PAH-OMC-010, the R-484 boundary replay and the R-490 state-weighted input before computation.

Freeze the full finite fixed-Q generator domain, the algebraic union of gauge- and anchor-invariant finite cylinders, the pointwise neutral projection and retained-root correspondence without changing any rate or functional.
Derive N(f)=max(2,m_f+1) from the declared interaction-closure column bound and prove the frontier footprint is separated after that stage on the neutral-inclusion image.

Construct the exact valid Q=1 fine state with its only charge at the newly added vertex and show that dropping the new column changes the retained charge to zero, so the projection is not total on Omega_(n+1,1).
Retain the R-484 hidden-diagonal defect 16/9, use R-490 C_sw=540 only as a domination input, and run independent, hostile and Lean cross-checks.
finding: The image-locality buffer is exact and the R-484 boundary defect is separated for n>=N(f), but the declared neutral projection is not a map from the full fine Q=1 state space to the coarse Q=1 state space: the new-column charge witness projects from Q=1 to Q=0. Therefore the all-state lift and generator identity are undefined on a positive-weight portion of the fine Gibbs domain.
decision_reason: The exact domain obstruction prevents a MAINLINE_ADVANCE without inventing a full-Q map or restricting the domain. It is not a numerical rate counterexample and does not refute PAH-001. A source-authorized total fixed-Q domain/map is required before exact intertwining or weak Gibbs-L2 convergence can be evaluated.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite domain/locality result. R-484 remains a local Q=0 boundary control, R-488 remains a Q=1 patch fixture, and R-490 remains a state-weighted domination input. No global common-core, infinite-volume, ordered-limit, continuum or physical claim is made.
evidence_level: T0 exact finite domain obstruction plus conditional image-locality arithmetic with primary/independent/hostile/integrated/Lean verification

source_authorities.role: immutable functional, move and rate source
Gibbs-weighted norm and conditional C_sw input

assumptions: PAH-001, PAH-OMC-004, PAH-OMC-008 and PAH-OMC-010 remain byte-identical at the pinned hashes.
The common cylinder algebra uses only finitely supported gauge- and anchor-invariant coordinates and does not add a conditional expectation.
The neutral projection means geometric retention and dropping of the new coordinates exactly as declared; no charge redistribution is implicit.
R-490 C_sw=540 is a domination coefficient only and supplies no generator equality.
missing_assumptions: A source-authorized full-Q common domain or full-Q refinement map that is total on Omega_(n+1,Q) and preserves the fixed charge.
An all-state rootwise equality proof after that total map is supplied.
A separately defined weak Gibbs-L2 defect/convergence test on the repaired common domain.
non_claims: No physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.
No universal weak Gibbs-L2 failure is claimed; the full-domain lift is undefined at this stage.
No PAH-001 functional, transition rate, counterterm, carrier, conditional average or regulator is changed.
next_action: Obtain exactly one source-authorized total fixed-Q common-domain/refinement-map contract, hash-pin it, then rerun all-state rootwise intertwining and the weighted Gibbs-L2 defect separately.
revisit_condition: Reopen only when that total map contract is present and independently verified; otherwise retain HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE and do not repeat finite patch tables.
stop_or_redesign: Do not report image-restricted locality as an all-state intertwining theorem.
Do not repair the charge-loss witness by conditional averaging, charge redistribution, rate fitting or Q=0 substitution.
Do not use C_sw=540 as a substitute for the missing common-domain theorem.
reproduction: Set-Location verification/lean; lake env lean Tect/R491.lean
